# FantasyID Dataset

## Overview
FantasyID is a standardized benchmark created by the Idiap Research Institute (Switzerland) for digital identity document manipulation detection, used in the ICCV 2025 DeepID Challenge. It contains bona-fide (authentic-style) and digitally manipulated fantasy ID cards across 13 distinct language templates (including Hindi `hin`, French `fra`, Arabic `ara`, Chinese `chi`, Russian `rus`, English `eng`, etc.).

## Purpose for VEDA-BORDER
Serves as the **Digital ID-Document Manipulation Benchmark** to independently evaluate manipulation detection across diverse international and domestic (Hindi) document layouts without using real PII.
